proof_body:
by
  intro d hd
  have hdneg : -d ≤ 0 := by omega
  have hnorm : ∀ x : Zsqrtd (-d), x.norm = x.re * x.re + d * (x.im * x.im) := by
    intro x; rw [Zsqrtd.norm_def]; ring
  have hirr : Irreducible (2 : Zsqrtd (-d)) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hu
      have := (Zsqrtd.norm_eq_one_iff' hdneg _).mpr hu
      rw [hnorm] at this
      simp at this
    · intro a b hab
      have h4 : a.norm * b.norm = 4 := by
        rw [← Zsqrtd.norm_mul, ← hab, hnorm]; simp
      have hane : 0 ≤ a.norm := Zsqrtd.norm_nonneg hdneg a
      have hno2 : ∀ x : Zsqrtd (-d), x.norm ≠ 2 := by
        intro x hx
        rw [hnorm] at hx
        by_cases him : x.im = 0
        · rw [him] at hx
          have h5 : x.re * x.re = 2 := by simpa using hx
          have h6 : x.re ≤ 1 ∨ 2 ≤ x.re := by omega
          have h7 : -1 ≤ x.re ∨ x.re ≤ -2 := by omega
          rcases h6 with h6 | h6 <;> rcases h7 with h7 | h7 <;> nlinarith
        · have h8 : 1 ≤ x.im * x.im := by
            have := mul_self_pos.mpr him
            omega
          nlinarith [mul_self_nonneg x.re]
      have h3 : a.norm = 1 ∨ b.norm = 1 := by
        have ha4 : a.norm ∣ 4 := ⟨_, h4.symm⟩
        have hle : a.norm ≤ 4 := Int.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) ha4
        have hpos : 0 < a.norm := by
          rcases hane.lt_or_eq with h | h
          · exact h
          · rw [← h] at h4; simp at h4
        have hc : a.norm = 1 ∨ a.norm = 2 ∨ a.norm = 3 ∨ a.norm = 4 := by omega
        rcases hc with h | h | h | h
        · exact Or.inl h
        · exact absurd h (hno2 a)
        · rw [h] at h4; omega
        · right; rw [h] at h4; omega
      rcases h3 with h | h
      · left; exact (Zsqrtd.norm_eq_one_iff' hdneg _).mp h
      · right; exact (Zsqrtd.norm_eq_one_iff' hdneg _).mp h
  have hnp : ¬ Prime (2 : Zsqrtd (-d)) := by
    intro hp
    have dvdiff : ∀ x : Zsqrtd (-d), (2 : Zsqrtd (-d)) ∣ x → (2 : ℤ) ∣ x.im := by
      rintro x ⟨c, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨c.im, by simp [Zsqrtd.im_mul]⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hk | hk⟩ := Int.even_or_odd' d
    · have : (2 : Zsqrtd (-d)) ∣ (⟨0, 1⟩ : Zsqrtd (-d)) * ⟨0, 1⟩ := by
        refine ⟨⟨-k, 0⟩, ?_⟩
        ext <;> simp [hk]
      rcases hp.2.2 _ _ this with h | h <;> exact absurd (dvdiff _ h) (by simp)
    · have : (2 : Zsqrtd (-d)) ∣ (⟨1, 1⟩ : Zsqrtd (-d)) * ⟨1, -1⟩ := by
        refine ⟨⟨k + 1, 0⟩, ?_⟩
        ext <;> simp [hk] <;> ring
      rcases hp.2.2 _ _ this with h | h <;> exact absurd (dvdiff _ h) (by simp)
  refine ⟨hirr, hnp, ?_⟩
  intro hu
  exact hnp ((UniqueFactorizationMonoid.irreducible_iff_prime).mp hirr)
target_source: ∀ d : ℤ, 3 ≤ d → Irreducible (2 : Zsqrtd (-d)) ∧ ¬ Prime (2 : Zsqrtd (-d)) ∧ ¬ UniqueFactorizationMonoid (Zsqrtd (-d))
